newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 1996 property deals up 79 pct in value on year.
newsitem.headline: HK 1996 property deals up 79 pct in value on year.

text.p: Hong Kong recorded 147,423 sale and purchase agreements worth HK$474.66 billion for residential and non-residential building units in 1996, up 78.6 percent in value from 1995, the government Land Registry said on Monday.
The number of deals rose 51 percent from 1995 and 28.3 from 1994, it said in a statement.
There were 16,843 sale and purchase agreements in December worth HK$69.3 billion, a 17.6 percent increase in value from November and up 159.5 percent compared with the same period in 1995, it said.
The number of deals in December rose 5.2 percent from November and 58.7 percent compared with the year-ago period, the statement said.
